{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the columns
columns = df.columns.tolist()
print(columns)

# Check unique values for site and arm
print(f"\nUnique sites: {df['site'].unique()}")
print(f"\nUnique arms: {df['arm'].unique()}")

# Check distribution of response by site
response_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print(f"\nResponse rate by site:\n{response_by_site}")"}
